objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed artifact created, edited, released, distributed, archived, revised, invalidated, reactivated, translated, and evaluated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type selected when creating a new document; can be changed or added to in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate documents for structuring and evaluation.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation for a document; not language-independent and the same for all languages.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Number assigned to a document; assignment can be adapted to requirements.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations through a user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used for personal authorization; the creator is automatically confirmed in this field by default.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers for review.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers, including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which document validity starts; updated for each newly released version.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the valid-until date and define when extended validity check is necessary.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from valid-from date and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained before physical deletion.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose subsequent change affects email notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose subsequent change affects workflow task distribution when the next version is released.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type used for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type that describes locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type that describes specific procedures within a framework or process sequence, details, and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type for detailed work steps in sub-processes that are usually relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or from which new documents can be generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object type that can supplement a document and is released and published directly via switches in the properties.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and automatically released with the main document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person who may act as reader, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, creator, initiator, or workflow participant.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used to assign authorizations and distribution to users.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system and assigned specifically to documents to assign read and change rights.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for an existing document that can be created without affecting document content or version history.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants during workflow-supported processes.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete workflow tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document when the validity expiry approaches and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document and processed by workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate an invalidated document and processed by workflow.

objs.name: distribution
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to a document for read authorization, email notification, acknowledgement, and dashboard assignment.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a document version.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific view populated with documents relevant to users.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Evaluation report or search available for documents in the system.

objs.name: translation
objs.description: Language version of released content or documents that is checked and released with workflow support.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Artifact with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Artifact with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Artifact with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of Master data with which documents can be linked.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type during creation of a new document.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one or more templates defined for the document type when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for uploaded external files or generated documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content with the implemented editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert the saved document to PDF with system support.

evts.name: display_document_on_web
evts.description: Display the current converted version on the web.

evts.name: change_document_content
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to document content.

evts.name: change_document_property
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to document properties.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Create a new editing version when released documents are changed or revised.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_reader
evts.description: Assign reader authorizations via user group assignment in the Reader attribute.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Assign a user as author for a document.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Assign additional personal change rights via the Co-authors attribute.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Assign a user as reviewer for a document.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Assign a user as releaser for a document.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add an Additional info object to a document.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an Attachment to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: modify_additional_info
evts.description: Modify additional information.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark a released Attachment for archiving and archive it with release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: delete_attachment
evts.description: Delete an Attachment when it is not released.

evts.name: start_release_process
evts.description: Initiate the workflow-supported approval process after document creation, attribute and content maintenance, and definition of document control.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation of the document in the first workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser decides whether a document is distributed to readers and releases it.

evts.name: reject_review
evts.description: Reject the document during review, canceling workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: reject_release
evts.description: Reject the document during release, canceling workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: Inform involved users of workflow task status, existence, creation of change proposal, editing results, distribution, or acknowledgement requests by email.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete their tasks with an electronic signature or without a signature for acknowledgement.

evts.name: document_electronic_signature
evts.description: Document signatures of individual participants in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, creating a new version in editing status.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the valid-until date.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Process a request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, deleting the validity extension request and updating the valid-until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process and delete the request when a new revised version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document to invalidate it.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the workflow for processing a request for AKS after attachment of the request.

evts.name: check_request_for_aks
evts.description: Creator of the request checks the request and document in the first step of the AKS process.

evts.name: approve_aks
evts.description: Reviewers and releasers review and approve the AKS.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare a document out of force, marking the last valid approved version with status Out of force.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive invalidated documents and attachments by revoking authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after declaration of Out of force.

evts.name: delete_document_physically
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the provided folder and select the document for reactivation.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the workflow for a request for reactivation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the request confirms reactivation in the workflow step.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Create a new version of the invalidated document and restore metadata, properties, authorizations, distribution list, and archived attachments.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution
evts.description: Maintain the distribution list in the cockpit for the document.

evts.name: assign_read_authorization
evts.description: Automatically assign read authorization to user groups and persons assigned to the distribution.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned user groups by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request recipients by email to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement of a document version.

evts.name: provide_acknowledgement_overview
evts.description: Provide author team with an overview of acknowledgements not yet confirmed.

evts.name: notify_all_acknowledgements_confirmed
evts.description: Notify the author team when all persons maintained in the distribution have confirmed acknowledgement of the current version.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards based on distribution groups per document.

evts.name: evaluate_document
evts.description: Evaluate documents, instructions, acknowledgements, or workflow status using reports and selection parameters.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content or documents into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release translated version with workflow support so it is visible in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Create a reference from a local document to the original document.

o2o.description: One or more document templates can be defined for each document type and selected when creating new document objects.
A pure object cover can be created for a document.
External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.
Additional information can be added to each document.
Attachments can be added to documents and are associated with the main document version.
Reader authorizations are assigned through user group assignment on the document.
Users can be assigned as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, creator, initiator, or reader for documents.
Authorization groups are assigned specifically to documents to assign read and change rights.
Users assigned to specific user groups are offered in selection lists and receive permissions.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for AKS is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
A distribution list is maintained per document.
User groups assigned to the distribution receive read authorization and notifications or acknowledgement tasks.
Persons assigned to the distribution receive read authorization and notifications or acknowledgement tasks.
Acknowledgements are confirmations for a document version.
Users confirm acknowledgement of documents.
Documents assigned through distribution are displayed in dashboards.
Users access dashboards populated with documents relevant to them.
Reports provide evaluations of documents stored in the system.
Released documents can have translated language versions.
For each document in a multi-client system, visibility in clients can be specified.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with Master data.
IT applications are given as an example of Master data.
Documents can reference other documents, and local documents can reference original documents.
